csv_scope_of_work: The City of Oak Point ( City ) invites qualified consulting firms to submit a proposal for the development of a comprehensive Plan that guides the City s future growth and development. This new Comprehensive Plan will serve as a strategic blueprint for land use, economic development, parks and open space, capital improvement, public services, and Hazard Mitigation. This project is partially funded by the State of Texas General Land Office Resilient Communities Grant Program. Final costs are to be negotiated after selection. The City is seeking a qualified planning firm, or team of qualified firms that can gather community input and draft a Comprehensive Plan with the following goals: o Land Use and Growth Management Development of future land use plan to accommodate responsible, well-coordinated growth in line with both the existing community and economic possibilities. Identify strategies for managing growth and preserving the Country Place character that has come to represent the City. Combine existing sub-area plans to one comprehensive vision for the City. o Neighborhood and Community Character Improve community aesthetic and quality of life. Preserve long term vitality of community character. Assess current and future Residential and Commercial land use needs. o Transportation, Walkability, Mobility Establish a plan to enact a comprehensive bike and pedestrian network within the City. Fiscal Plan for Asset Management utilizing results of current 2026 Pavement Condition Index. o Parks, Natural Resources Develop Parks Master Plan Identify existing and future needs for active and passive parks and recreation within the City. Evaluate and enhance tree and open space protection. Evaluate and assess current tree mitigation requirements. o Hazard Mitigation Provide analysis on high-risk hazards for the community and how best to mitigate via land use, engineering standards, and building codes. o Public Facilities, Infrastructure, and Services Identify needs for any future public facilities. Recommendations regarding street and roadway improvement strategies. Fiscal analysis of and how the City services are supported in the longterm. o Economic Development Utilize recently adopted strategic plan.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Site Evaluation/Selection, Housing & Urban Development, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Transportation Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
